entities.name: RRC protocol
entities.description: Radio Resource Control protocol that provides services to upper layers in the 5G NR protocol stack.

entities.name: Broadcast of common control information
entities.description: Service that broadcasts common control information to UEs.

entities.name: Notification of UEs in RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Service that notifies UEs in RRC_IDLE state about events such as mobile terminating calls.

entities.name: Notification of UEs about ETWS and/or CMAS
entities.description: Service that notifies UEs about Earthquake and Tsunami Warning System (ETWS) and/or Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS) alerts.

entities.name: Transfer of dedicated signalling
entities.description: Service that transfers dedicated signalling information between network and UE.

entities.name: Broadcast of positioning assistance data
entities.description: Service that broadcasts positioning assistance data to UEs.

entities.name: Transfer of application layer measurement configuration and reporting
entities.description: Service that transfers application layer measurement configuration and reporting information.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not actively connected but can receive notifications.
